mechanism: Foscarnet causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair ramipril efficacy and increase risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and potassium closely; adjust ramipril dosing based on creatinine clearance; consider alternative antivirals if possible; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy.
